Two services, one connected space

CCTV and home automation do different jobs. They can also work well side by side.

CCTV surveillance

Helps you see and record what happens in the areas you choose.

  • Cameras and recording equipment
  • Viewing live and recorded footage
  • Coverage planned around your premises

Home and small-office automation

Helps you control lighting and connected devices more conveniently.

  • Smart lighting and connected devices
  • Routines and everyday control
  • Set up around how you use the space

How they may complement each other

Both rely on a dependable network connection, and they can be planned together so that equipment, cabling, and connectivity are considered once. Whether to combine them is your choice.

Frequently asked questions

What does installation require?

Requirements depend on the premises and the equipment chosen, including cabling routes, power, and mounting locations. We assess your site first and explain what is needed in the quotation.

Do I need internet to use CCTV?

A CCTV system can record without internet. Internet connectivity is needed for remote viewing, and the quality of that connection affects how well remote viewing works.

Can I view my cameras from my phone?

Remote viewing can be set up on supported devices. It depends on your equipment, your internet connection, and a suitable configuration, so we confirm what is possible for your system.

Will it work with the devices I already have?

Compatibility varies between products. Tell us what you already own and we will assess whether it can be included.

Can you maintain or upgrade an existing system?

Yes. Maintenance, troubleshooting, and upgrades are part of our service, including for systems we did not install, subject to assessment.

Does CCTV prevent incidents?

No system can promise that. CCTV gives you visibility and a record of what happens in the areas covered, which can support decisions and follow-up.
